podcast.body: A track from *El Camino* that achieved massive global success, including platinum sales and triple platinum status in Canada. It secured two Grammy awards, and its iconic single-shot video featuring security guard Derek T. Tuggle dancing and lip-syncing quickly garnered nearly half a million YouTube views within 24 hours of its release. "Love that video with Derek T. Tuggle's Dancing. That's Lonely Boy from the block keys seventh studio album called El Camino."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: A track from the seventh studio album, *El Camino*, which earned two Grammy awards. Its accompanying music video became a viral sensation, featuring a simple single shot of security guard Derek T. Tuggle dancing and lip-syncing, garnering nearly half a million views on YouTube within its first 24 hours after a more elaborate, original video failed. "That's Lonely Boy from the Black Keys seventh studio album called El Camino."
